title: Exhaust desktop-stack upgrade paths for glib 0.20.0+
description:
Validate every viable desktop-stack upgrade route that could lift glib to 0.20.0+ without widening privileges or regressing the Tauri shell.

Execution plan:
1. Bump tauri and tauri-build together to the newest compatible line.
2. Regenerate Cargo.lock and inspect the resolved desktop dependency tree.
3. Verify whether gtk/glib now resolves to glib 0.20.0+ across the workspace.
4. Run the workspace and desktop gate commands for each viable upgrade attempt.
5. If the floor still does not move, record the exhausted attempt set and preserve the blocker evidence.

Pursue this slice until all viable upgrade attempts are exhausted or the lockfile resolves glib 0.20.0+.
acceptance_criteria: All viable desktop-stack upgrade attempts have been tried and documented; either Cargo.lock resolves glib 0.20.0+ or the remaining blocker is explicitly proven exhausted with upstream incompatibility evidence; the lockfile test reflects the final state; and workspace/desktop validation commands pass for the chosen resolution.
notes:
This is the execution slice for the glib floor lift effort. Keep the issue open until the stack is proven on glib 0.20.0+ or the upgrade paths are exhausted.
Attempt 1: `cargo update -p tauri -p tauri-build` locked 0 packages to newer compatible versions. `cargo search tauri` reports 2.11.3 as latest; `cargo search tauri-build` reports 2.6.3 as latest. The current resolver still keeps glib 0.18.5 via gtk 0.18.2, so no floor lift yet.
Attempt 2: crates.io search shows the current desktop stack is already at the latest published line for the Tauri 2 path: tauri 2.11.3, tauri-build 2.6.3, wry 0.55.1, webkit2gtk 2.0.2, gtk 0.18.2. No newer crates in this path lift the glib floor, so the semver-compatible upgrade surface is exhausted.
close_reason: Semver-compatible desktop-stack upgrade attempts exhausted on current Tauri 2 path; Cargo.lock still resolves glib 0.18.5 through gtk 0.18.2, so the root advisory remains blocked by RT-00i.2.2.

title: Record gtk/glib compatibility decision for Dependabot alert
description:
Document the current Tauri desktop stack incompatibility that keeps the glib 0.18.5 Dependabot alert open and capture the non-blocking exception or upstream release requirement.

## Rationale
The current workspace resolves tauri v2.11.3 -> gtk v0.18.2 -> glib v0.18.5, and cargo update -p glib --precise 0.20.0 --locked fails because gtk v0.18.2 requires glib ^0.18. The blocker is therefore upstream compatibility, not a missing local patch.

## Alternatives Considered
- Upgrade glib in place: rejected because the current gtk line cannot accept glib 0.20.0.
- Widen manifest bounds: rejected because it would expand the desktop surface without a compatible upstream release.
- Leave the alert open with documented blocker evidence: accepted as the safest short-term path until an upstream-compatible desktop stack is available.
acceptance_criteria: The decision records the tauri -> gtk -> glib 0.18.5 path, the cargo update failure against glib 0.20.0, the current publish-ready docs state, and the explicit condition required before the alert can be closed.
notes: Created as the decision landing zone for the RT-00i.2 blocker so the alert can remain open without losing rationale.
close_reason: Decision recorded in docs and publish-gate artifacts; upstream gtk/glib incompatibility remains the blocker for the live Dependabot alert.
